name: Warnken Law
about: Warnken Law is a personal injury firm with a single office in Pikesville.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Maryland does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: 2 of the firm's attorneys share a surname with a disciplined attorney, and for Jeffrey T. Weinberg 1 of 2 decision(s) naming this surname have no searchable text, so they can be neither tied to nor ruled out against this attorney. The decisions that cannot be read are scans without searchable text, so this is a limit of the published record. Nothing here says the firm's attorney is that person.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Maryland publishes no business register we can query. SDAT's entity search is a form rather than a dataset, its bulk data is sold rather than published, and the state's open data portal carries a count of businesses instead of the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 12 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 893 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2003-03-11, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
